reconstructed_contract.source_2: signature `controls.sh b LANE FREEZE REV OUTDIR`: FREEZE used only for `git show "$FREEZE:$E/<counter>"`, REV used only as `clone_at` target
reconstructed_contract.source_3: in-body comments (`CTL_POS — the real repair at REV must pass both counters`) and contract.json claims.C1/C2.controls with CTL_POS pre-registered true
reconstructed_contract.evidence: same committed harness bytes give CONTROLS_B: 3/3 at REV=c2108100 (receipts/r54-phaseB-at-certified-rev.stdout)

q1_does_phase_B_score_the_revision_it_ce.round_54: no in fact (scored the freeze 077d431e); yes in capability (3/3 at c2108100 with identical bytes)

mechanism_of_the_round54_error: the harness clones $REV (never FREEZE) at every revision of the file: 441c26be, 19c7558, 077d431e, c2108100
it was handed the freeze: controls-b.stdout prints rev=077d431e6996 on both CTL_POS lines, and 077d431e is the round-54 freeze
the content revision did not exist yet: 7fa9a5e^ == 077d431e, the receipt was first committed in 7fa9a5e (12:21:35), and c2108100 is 12:22:15 (40 s later)

the 2/3 is the fingerprint of a half-carrying tree: C2's fix (99c3bc88) is an ancestor of the freeze, C1's re-key (7fa9a5e) is not; frozen counters at the freeze reproduce the receipt byte-for-byte (C1 total=4 false, C2 total=0 true)
the gate opened anyway: 4 non-empty blobs descending from FREEZE + regex ^CONTROLS_B: [0-9]*/[0-9]*, with n/m never compared, .exit (value 1) never read, rev= never compared to REV

findings.defect: CTL_BREAK_c2's anchor literal `emit_err(f"repeat-control: could-not-evaluate: {exc}")` does not exist in the tree it must break; the landed fix uses `{message}`. count({exc})=0 at base, at the round-55 freeze 631cd645, and at the tip 133b2ce.
findings.consequence: the assert raises, gitcommit finds nothing to commit, `|| exit 2` fires, and phase B exits 2 WITHOUT printing CONTROLS_B — so the receipt the deciding gate requires cannot be produced at any revision

findings.defect: CTL_SKIP_c1's REN derivation (`git log --format=%H --diff-filter=R $REV -- <new-path>`) returns empty at every revision: rename pairing needs both sides in the pathspec
findings.consequence: the 'values-only' control pastes an empty value for R54.7, so its comment 'carrying every corrected value' is false and that class is never exercised with a correct value

findings.defect: the control gate requires only presence/size/ancestry plus `^CONTROLS_[AB]: [0-9]*/[0-9]* as pre-registered`; it never requires n==m, never reads controls-*.exit, and never compares the receipts' rev= prefix to REV. Textually identical to round-54 :52-59.
findings.consequence: CONTROLS_B: 0/3 opens the gate; round 54's own receipt (2/3, exit 1, 1 CTL_MISMATCH) opened it and DECIDING_RUN_EXIT was 0
findings.command: bash receipts/gate-reproduction.stdout producer against a clone at c2108100

findings.defect: OUTDIR (5th positional) is parsed and never used; the harness writes no invocation receipt, so a caller's arguments are unauditable except through the counter's rev= field
findings.consequence: the 'receipt re-stated at the freeze (bytes unchanged; the verdict line above stands)' trailer of round-54 commit 5564954 could not be falsified from the harness's own output

findings.defect: requiring each receipt's last touching commit to descend from FREEZE rewards re-committing a stale receipt after the freeze
findings.consequence: exactly what round-54 commit 5564954 did ('control receipts re-stated at the freeze commit (the gate requires their last commit to descend from it)')

minimal_correct_shape: harness refuses REV that cannot carry the claim: resolves; merge-base --is-ancestor FREEZE REV; rev-list --count FREEZE..REV > 0; exit 3 with nothing scored
gate binds the receipt to the certified revision: every CTL line's rev=<12 hex> must be a prefix of REV
gate reads the verdict instead of matching it: ^CONTROLS_B: ([0-9]+)/\1 as pre-registered$ and controls-b.exit content == 0
mutation controls prove they fired: exactly one anchor, identifier-invariant (\{[a-z_]+\}), refuse BY NAME (CTL_x CANNOT-FIRE) instead of aborting with a traceback
harness writes stdout + exit code + argv into OUTDIR so no receipt is ever 're-stated' by hand
residual_risk_for_round_55: phase B certifies whatever it is handed. If the L1 hands it the current freeze 133b2ce, both CTL_POS read true there (already observed) and the gate accepts the receipt — a clean repeat of R54.1 with no mismatch line to give it away. Only the rev=-prefix check (tooth 2) catches it, and it is not in the frozen gate.
